thread:
nora: Deploybot reports rollout v3.4.0 -> prod complete at 2026-05-12T11:15:01Z. I see eu-south heartbeat p95 drifted to ~160ms. KV + prefill probes are nominal. Any volunteers to take quick triage?

deploy-bot: rollout v3.4.0 finished (rollout_id=rl-7f2) :white_check_mark:

diego: on it. pulling quickcheck now. command: `./ops/smoketest --probe heartbeat --region eu-south --window 8m`

sam: heads-up I flipped a tiny tokenizer normalization tweak in this release; could be related.

diego: quickcheck output: p50=42ms, p95=162ms, p99=260ms, error_rate=0.07%. Not catastrophic but tail higher than baseline (~95ms).

nora: low errors, so prefer in-region mitigation. Options: 1) pin eu-south to previous variant 2) do a weight override to keep sample traffic. Which do we prefer?

sam: since it's likely tokenizer microchange, pin to v3.3.9 for 15m to see immediate effect. We don't need continued sampling for a minute.

diego: pin command: `redwood route pin --region eu-south --variant v3.3.9 --duration 15m --reason "postdeploy tail drift"`

sre-bot: route pin applied (eu-south -> v3.3.9) by diego at 2026-05-12T11:18:12Z. TTL 15m.

nora: nina (not in thread) - please start long-tail synth in eu-south and post traces. sam, can you prepare a microbench for tokenize times?

sam: running tokenizer bench across variants now. will post delta.

diego: post-pin quickcheck (5m): p95=102ms, p99=150ms, errors 0.03%. Looks much better after pin.

sam: tokenizer bench delta: v3.4.0 tokenize p95 +23ms vs v3.3.9 on long inputs. Link: https://internal/perf/tokenize/20260512-diff

nora: that points to the release change. Given this, plan: 1) keep pin until we merge a small patch reverting the normalization and run CI perf checks, 2) update release notes + ops incident entry, 3) schedule targeted patch v3.4.1. If diego sees any error upticks, we rollback fully.

diego: agree. opening incident note in releases doc.

sre-bot: pin TTL expiring in 2m.

diego: pin expired, unpinning now: `redwood route unpin --region eu-south --variant v3.3.9`

sre-bot: route pin removed by diego at 2026-05-12T11:33:12Z.

nora: post-unpin quickcheck: p95=110ms, p99=168ms, errors 0.05%. Slight drift but acceptable. We'll keep monitoring for 1h and proceed with a tokenizer patch. Closing thread unless we see regression. :white_check_mark:
